8030.title: Pointer input without native focus recovery
8030.rootCauseOneLine: A load-armed pointer listener only clears focus rejection; it never requests native keyboard focus when a pointer press reaches an unfocused page.

prReviews.verdict: UNVERIFIED — closed and unmerged; static review only
prReviews.topFinding: Its persistent pointer handler addresses the manager-level gap in principle; native macOS behavior was not tested and its branch was not executed.

8030.proposedFix: First capture native focus ordering on macOS. If confirmed, add eligible-user pointer focus recovery while retaining reload, visibility, automation, lease, server and host-focus guards.
8030.caveats: Both clean runs use the existing Electron test doubles. Native macOS, Linear editing, document.hasFocus and caret behavior are unverified; no screenshot or fix PR was produced.
